opening_message:
Ticket 1: Kenneth Burch (employee ID E007) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E007.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Kenneth Burch (E007) is a full-time Analyst requesting write access to Payroll. As a full-time employee, write is within the allowed maximum (admin would require owning the Payroll Specialist role, which this employee does not hold). Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E007 is a contractor with basic security training (note that this conflicts with the earlier note claiming full-time). As a contractor with basic training, max access is read; requested write exceeds max, so recommend granting read.
reason: The two notes conflict on employment type: HR reports full_time (recommending write), while Security DB reports contractor with basic security training (recommending read). Given the unresolved conflict, I apply the stricter constraint: a contractor with basic training may have at most read access to Payroll (write requires advanced training; admin is never allowed for contractors). Requested write exceeds this maximum, so the final granted level is read.

The access policy:
1. full_time: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist role.

If full_time Analyst requesting Payroll write: max is write, grant write.
If contractor with basic training requesting write: max is read (contractor can get write only with advanced training), so grant read.
